[1] For Filipino runners, it's the equivalent of a national championship: the race where age-group and elite titles are decided, where provincial qualifiers converge, and where the running community's calendar peaks. RUNRIO Inc., the organiser, is the gold standard in Philippine race production.

sections.heading: The Venue: Clark City, Pampanga
paragraphs: Clark City is a former US airbase turned master-planned development zone in Pampanga, roughly 1.5–2 hours north of Manila. [1] The wide, well-maintained roads, minimal traffic, and open layout make it one of the Philippines' best running venues — flat, fast, and free of the congestion that plagues Manila-based races. December in Clark is dry-season, with morning temperatures in the mid-20s Celsius.
